radish modding tools by rmemr
https://www.nexusmods.com/witcher3/mods/3620

Shipped with Conjunction with rmemr's permission, as long as the tools are unmodified and come with their crc files.
The zip in this folder is the file from Nexus, as downloaded, under its own name:

  radish.modding.tools-v2020-11-21-3620-v2020-11-21-1606002572.zip
  25 611 051 bytes
  sha256 f7417b7fb65160a7e11b8d9b32f597ae7a8f229ddd1e22797edb983526813b1c

Compare it with the download on the Nexus page. On its first start Conjunction unpacks it into
%LOCALAPPDATA%\Conjunction\radish-tools and checks every exe and dll against radish's own
crc.radish-modding-tools.current.txt. Conjunction never changes a file of radish.

The licences of radish's parts are inside the zip (w3speech-phoneme-extractor-LICENSE-gpl-3.0.txt,
licenses.lipsync-3rd-party).
